en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.574 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever offers children (to Allah (swt), i.e., loses them and bears the loss patiently, seeking reward from Allah (swt)), they will shield him from the Fire, by the permission of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic."
